subject: CALCULUS BC
pageTitle: Integration by Parts: The LIATE Rule and Worked Examples
description: Use ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du and the LIATE rule to choose u, with two fully worked calculus examples.
caption: Integration by parts in 7 swipes: the formula, how to choose u, and two worked examples. Save this for your BC exam prep. Free Calculus BC study guide at precisstudy.com/calc-bc (no sign-up).

slides.title: THE FORMULA
slides.note: Pick u so that du is simpler than u.

slides.title: CHOOSE u WITH LIATE
slides.note: The first type in this list is usually u.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
steps: u = x, dv = eˣ dx, so du = dx and v = eˣ
∫ x eˣ dx = x eˣ − ∫ eˣ dx

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
steps: u = x, dv = cos x dx, so du = dx and v = sin x
∫ x cos x dx = x sin x − ∫ sin x dx
= x sin x + cos x + C
slides.answer: x sin x + cos x + C

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Choosing u = eˣ and dv = x dx
points: That makes the new integral harder.
